# Bundled browser dependencies

These pinned files are served locally so the application does not require a public CDN
at runtime. Do not replace them with floating CDN URLs.

| File | Upstream package | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tribute-5.1.3.*` | [Tribute](https://github.com/zurb/tribute) | 5.1.3 | MIT |
| `minisearch-7.1.1.min.js` | [MiniSearch](https://github.com/lucaong/minisearch) | 7.1.1 | MIT |
| `d3-7.8.5.min.js` | [D3](https://github.com/d3/d3) | 7.8.5 | ISC |
| `markmap-bootstrap-0.16.1.js` | Local sequential loader | 0.16.1 | Project code |
| `markmap-lib-0.16.1.min.js` | [markmap-lib](https://github.com/markmap/markmap) | 0.16.1 | MIT |
| `markmap-view-0.16.0.min.js` | [markmap-view](https://github.com/markmap/markmap) | 0.16.0 | MIT |
| `markmap-toolbar-0.16.0.*` | [markmap-toolbar](https://github.com/markmap/markmap) | 0.16.0 | MIT |
| `markmap-autoloader-0.16.1.min.js` | [markmap-autoloader](https://github.com/markmap/markmap) | 0.16.1 | MIT |

The files were downloaded from the matching jsDelivr/cdnjs release endpoints. Their
upstream copyright comments are retained in the bundled source.
